verdict.description: approve = ready to proceed; revise = at least one blocking item must be fixed and the gate re-run

summary.description: One-paragraph judgment: what was checked and why the verdict

blocking.description: Must be empty for verdict=approve. Each item is a concrete defect that blocks proceeding.

where.description: file:line or plan-step this blocks on

issue.description: the concrete defect / plan deviation / correctness or safety hole

fix.description: the specific change that resolves it

plan_deviations.description: Places the implementation diverged from the approved plan (empty if faithful)
